basic_info.description: First come first serve no lottery. Applications are being accepted on a first come, first served basis starting on 4/22/2025 at 8:00 AM PST. Any applications uploaded prior to 8:00 AM PT on April 22, 2025 will automatically be deleted and considered an invalid application for the first come, first served process-bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 2 people = $119,900; 3 = $134,850; 4 = $149,850; 5 = $161,850 etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. For applications and instructions go to the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org)  Fair Housing Opportunity.
